# Vela cup shape drawing register

The Vela cup drawing identifies a round mouth, a recessed foot and three inspection orientation marks. The cup line is a fictional new form and has no jurisdiction-specific food-contact certificate in this corpus.

## Inspection references
Use the [measurement manual](../bench/measurement-manual.md#warped-rim) for rim-warp orientations and acceptance values. This drawing deliberately omits tolerances so it cannot compete with the maintained criterion. The drawing defines shape identity, not acceptance, glaze classification or certification.
